concept: Soft-glam beauty bar palette for Chicago Beauty in DeKalb, IL. A blush-rose/mauve-pink primary leads the look, lifted by a champagne-gold accent and grounded in warm taupe ink over creamy soft-white backgrounds. The result reads pretty, premium and feminine while every text/UI pairing holds WCAG-AA.
contrastNotes: Verified ratios: ink #3A2D2B on bg #FBF6F2 = 12.3:1 (>=7); ink-soft #7A655F on bg = 5.08:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #A24E6C = 5.47:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 5.09:1 (>=3). Extras: ink on surface white = 13.21:1; ink on surface-alt = 11.08:1; ink-soft on surface-alt = 4.57:1; white on primary-dark #7E3A52 = 8.03:1 (use for hover/pressed states). Champagne-gold accent #B08438 on bg = 3.15:1 and white on accent = 3.39:1 — accent meets AA for large text/UI and decorative use only; pair gold text with ink or use it as a fill/border, not for small body copy.
